items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: That's where Sammy Stewart brought his band from Columbus, Ohio.

ctx.x: That's where Freddy Keppard played. He had a group there, and big band there, Freddy Keppard and Nate Brady. Auto Café was on one side of the street, and the Taylor Cafe was on the other side. That's where Sammy Stewart brought his band from Columbus, Ohio. And up about two blocks near Kermit Avenue was the Sunset. That was Carl Carroll Dickerson. Then they had the (unintelligible) the Radio Inn.
Now, the Radio Inn is a new one on me. Who did you say played there?
